profile.summary: A professional membership organization, founded in 2013 by charter school authorizing staff from school districts and county offices of education, that supports the people who oversee charter schools in California. It offers consulting, training, toolkits for reviewing charter petitions and annual reports, webinars and an annual conference.

sources.title: California Charter Authorizing Professionals - Nonprofit Explorer - ProPublica

review.notes: The agenda name 'CA Charter Authorizing Professionals' (Rocklin, CA; Charter Schools Office services agreement) matches the 501(c)(3) California Charter Authorizing Professionals (EIN 47-3234553, Rocklin, CA), whose work supporting district charter authorizers fits what OUSD's Charter Schools Office would buy. ProPublica, the contact page and the about page support the cited fields and the neutral summary; I found no OUSD-specific confirmation, and web search was unavailable, but no conflicting similarly named organization appeared.
